question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**constantly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about an old man.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**constantly**'.
 
• It means 'always; again and again'. (सदा; बराबर, बार-बार, लगातार)
 
 
• *Example: The situation is **constantly** changing*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *An old man lived in the village. He was one of the most unfortunate people in the world. The whole village was tired of him; he was always gloomy, he **constantly** complained and was always in a bad mood. The (4) _____ he lived, the more vile he was becoming and the more (5) ____ were his words.*
